fightSong.title: Catch the Wave
fightSong.lyrics: Paddle out at break of day / San Diego's here to play / Catch the wave and ride it in / Surfers always gonna win!

stadium.name: The Break
stadium.tradition: The Wave Check — a surf report is read pre-game. If waves are 3-5 feet and glassy, automatic win. It's never happened.

fanCulture.description: They show up in board shorts in December. After touchdowns they do the 'shaka.' Very chill, very competitive.
fanCulture.tailgate: On the beach, with a cooler.

rivalries.name: The SoCal Showdown
rivalries.narrative: San Diego vs LA. We have better tacos.

cityFlavor: Perfect weather, perfect waves, perfect fish tacos. We never left.
